task.title: Simplify generated state graph lenses
task.summary: Refactor generated state output to expose a compact Decision, Knowledge, Work, Execution, Proof default lens while preserving exact trace/audit expansion for gateways.

goal.outcome: Default CodeWiki state and graph views are simpler and lower-token while trace/audit lenses still expose full evidence refs.
acceptance: Default state/view groups hot context into Decision, Knowledge, Work, Execution, and Proof families.
Build and validation internals collapse to badges in default views when not the next action.
Trace/audit lenses expand exact source refs, requirements, validation reports, and content proof for gateways.
State/graph output remains generated and does not become canonical truth.
non_goals: Do not drop any evidence needed by validation, archive, restore, or publication.
Do not implement diagram_ref auditing in this task.
verification: Add graph/state tests for default lens and trace/audit expansion.

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Implementation validation must not reuse builder thought context and must cite checked content proof.

next_loop.reason: The next gateway must independently validate implementation evidence and cite checked content proof.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Default state/view groups hot context into Decision, Knowledge, Work, Execution, and Proof families.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: buildGraph now writes views.lenses.default with five ordered family cards; readCodewikiState include=graph reports graph:default-lens with node_count=5 and family badges; Control Room graph prepends lens_family nodes. Covered by tests/smoke/graph-lenses.test.mjs and updated hot-context test.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Build and validation internals collapse to badges in default views when not the next action.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: buildGraphLensViews records build/validation badge totals and collapsed counts, and applyDefaultLensCompaction marks non-next build/validation nodes default_hidden/default_collapsed. Graph-lenses and hot-context tests assert non-next build/validation nodes are not exposed in default Control Room graph.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Trace/audit lenses expand exact source refs, requirements, validation reports, and content proof for gateways.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: views.lenses.trace expands requirement_rows, semantic_change_rows, canonical_source_refs, and build_refs; views.lenses.audit expands validation_reports, validation_isolation, audit_evidence_refs, content_proof_refs, reconciliation_items, and gap rows. Graph-lenses smoke asserts exact requirement, build, validation, audit, and content-proof refs.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: State/graph output remains generated and does not become canonical truth.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: Graph spec now documents lenses as generated read models only; all lens data is emitted by buildGraph/CodewikiRebuilder into .codewiki/index_graph.json. No canonical roadmap/knowledge truth was moved into generated graph.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Add graph/state tests for default lens and trace/audit expansion; run codewiki_state and generated-parity audit.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: Added tests/smoke/graph-lenses.test.mjs and updated tests/smoke/hot-context.test.mjs. Ran codewiki_state include=summary,roadmap,graph,session taskId=TASK-004 and codewiki_audit generated-parity/changed plus full deterministic audit set.

closure_brief.user_intent: Continue roadmap with TASK-004: Simplify generated state graph lenses.
implemented_changes: Added generated default graph lens with Decision, Knowledge, Work, Execution, and Proof families.
Collapsed non-next build and validation internals into badges/default_hidden metadata while keeping exact graph nodes for expansion.
Added trace and audit graph lenses that expand requirement rows, canonical source refs, validation reports, audit refs, and content proofs.
Updated codewiki_state graph output and source-owned include values for trace/audit expansion.
Updated Control Room graph/status model to surface lens family nodes and counts.
Added graph/state lens smoke coverage and updated hot-context expectations.
Documented generated lens contract in the system graph spec and tool catalog.
acceptance_evidence: tests/smoke/graph-lenses.test.mjs asserts default five-family lens, collapsed build/validation internals, trace/audit exact expansion, state output, and Control Room graph model.
tests/smoke/hot-context.test.mjs asserts default graph source is graph:default-lens and UI graph count is five lens families while archive detail stays explicit-only.
CodeWiki audit passes deterministic profiles except expected changed-generated warnings before commit.
non_goals_preserved: Did not drop validation/archive/restore/publication evidence; exact refs remain in trace/audit/archive views.
Did not implement diagram_ref auditing beyond using existing diagram counts in lens badges.
Did not make generated graph output canonical truth.
remaining_risks: Live Pi tool schema requires reload before trace/audit include values are accepted in this current harness.

risks: Default lens family classification is deterministic heuristic over node kind/layer/path and may need refinement as new node kinds appear.

Control Room still keeps raw visible nodes in the graph model after lens family nodes; raw build/validation internals are collapsed by default_hidden unless next action, but other raw node types remain visible for context.
